caseName: Ford Motor Co. v. Gordon Form Lathe Co.
caseNameFull: Ford Motor Co. v. Gordon Form Lathe Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Drury W. Cooper and I. Joseph Farley for petitioner.

opinions.text:
The petition for rehearing is granted and the order entered June 7, 1943, 319 U. S. 738, is vacated. The petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is granted.

Mr. Justice Roberts and Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
